当我们感到压力时，交感神经系统会被激活（战斗或逃跑反应），心率加快，呼吸变浅。: When we feel stressed, the sympathetic nervous system is activated (the fight-or-flight response): the heart beats faster and breathing gets shallow. 对每条 B 类，深呼吸一次，在心里说「我选择暂时放下，这不是我能控制的」。: For each type B worry, take a deep breath and say to yourself, 'I choose to put this down for now; it's not something I can control.'
时间到。合上笔记，如果之后担忧再冒出来，提醒自己「明天担忧时间再处理」。: Time's up. Close your notes. If the worry comes back later, remind yourself: 'I'll deal with it in tomorrow's worry time.'
给担忧一个固定窗口，反而能减少它占据你的时间。: Giving worry a fixed window actually reduces how much of your time it takes.
大部分我们担心的事情永远不会发生——但写下来会让你看得更清楚。: Most of what we worry about never happens — but writing it down helps you see it more clearly.
担忧时间结束。你已经把该做的整理好了，剩下的交给明天。: Worry time is over. You've sorted what needs doing; leave the rest for tomorrow.
用实际行动检验消极预测是否成真。比如你觉得「打招呼会被无视」——试试看，结果可能: Test whether a negative prediction comes true by actually doing something. For example, if you think 'they'll ignore me if I say hello', try it — the result may surprise you.
你害怕会发生什么？把它写成具体的预测句。比如「如果我在群里发言，没人会回应」。: What are you afraid will happen? Write it as a specific prediction, e.g. 'If I post in the group chat, nobody will reply.'

你有多相信这个预测？（0-100%）: How much do you believe this prediction? (0–100%)
写下你要做的事、什么时候做、怎么判断结果。比如「明天开会时说一个想法，看看是否有: Write down what you will do, when, and how you'll judge the result, e.g. 'Share one idea in tomorrow's meeting and see if anyone responds.'
最坏的结果是什么？如果真的发生了，你能怎么应对？写下来给自己一颗定心丸。: What's the worst that could happen? If it did, how would you cope? Write it down to reassure yourself.
对自己说「我决定在____时候做这个实验」。做完后回来记录实际结果。: Tell yourself, 'I'll do this experiment at ____.' Afterwards, come back and record what actually happened.
我们的大脑很擅长预测坏事——但它的准确率其实不高。: Our brains are good at predicting bad things — but they aren't very accurate.
关键不是结果好不好，而是你敢于去验证，而不是一直猜。: What matters isn't whether the result is good, but that you dared to test it instead of guessing.
记得实验后回来记录结果。你会发现现实往往比想象的好。: Remember to come back and record the result. You'll often find reality is better than you imagined.
学会识别 10 种常见的思维陷阱：非黑即白、灾难化、读心术……知道陷阱在哪，就不: Learn to spot 10 common thinking traps: all-or-nothing thinking, catastrophising, mind-reading... Once you know where the traps are, you're less likely to fall in.
写下困扰你的想法: Write down the thought bothering you
最近有什么反复出现的消极念头？比如「我永远学不会」「所有人都不喜欢我」。: What negative thought keeps coming back lately? E.g. 'I'll never learn this' or 'Everyone dislikes me.'
看看它属于哪种歪曲：①非黑即白 ②以偏概全 ③灾难化 ④读心术 ⑤「应该」思维: Which distortion is it? ① All-or-nothing ② Overgeneralising ③ Catastrophising ④ Mind-reading ⑤ 'Should' statements ⑥ Labelling ⑦ Discounting the positive ⑧ Emotional reasoning ⑨ Magnifying/minimising ⑩ Personalising
比如：「我永远学不会」→ 这是「非黑即白」+「灾难化」。给它贴上标签。: For example: 'I'll never learn this' → all-or-nothing + catastrophising. Give it a label.
去掉歪曲后，这个想法会变成什么？比如「这个技能我还在学，现在不熟练不代表永远不会: Without the distortion, what does the thought become? E.g. 'I'm still learning this skill; not being good at it yet doesn't mean I never will be.'
每个人都会有认知歪曲，这是大脑的「快捷方式」，但不一定准确。: Everyone has cognitive distortions. They are the brain's 'shortcuts', but they aren't always accurate.
找到歪曲的名字就像给幽灵照了手电筒——它就没那么可怕了。: Naming the distortion is like shining a torch on a ghost — it becomes much less scary.
练得多了，你会自动识别出这些陷阱，不再轻易被带跑。: With practice, you'll spot these traps automatically and stop getting carried away.
给一个你想感谢的人写几句话。不需要寄出去，写的过程本身就能提升幸福感。: Write a few lines to someone you want to thank. You don't have to send it; the writing itself boosts wellbeing.
想一个对你有正面影响的人。可以是家人、朋友、老师，甚至陌生人。: Think of someone who has had a positive influence on you — family, a friend, a teacher, even a stranger.
他/她做了什么让你感动或受益？写下 1-2 件具体的事。: What did they do that moved you or helped you? Write down 1–2 specific things.
这些事对你的生活产生了什么影响？你当时和现在分别是什么感受？: How did these things affect your life? How did you feel then, and how do you feel now?
用你自己的话，写下你想对他/她说的感谢。真诚就好，不需要文采。: In your own words, write the thanks you want to give them. Just be sincere; no need for fancy writing.
读一遍你写的内容，感受心中的温暖。如果你愿意，也可以真的发给对方。: Read what you wrote and feel the warmth inside. If you like, you can actually send it to them.
感恩不是客套，是让自己重新看见生活中的善意。: Gratitude isn't politeness; it's seeing the kindness in your life again.
写得越具体越好——「谢谢你那天下雨帮我带了伞」比「谢谢你对我好」更有力量。: The more specific the better — 'thank you for bringing me an umbrella that rainy day' is more powerful than 'thank you for being nice to me'.
写完了吗？这封信本身就是一份礼物，给你自己的。: Finished? This letter is itself a gift — to you.
当你不想做任何事的时候，先安排一件小小的愉悦活动或成就活动，用行动带动情绪。: When you don't feel like doing anything, plan one small pleasant or achievable activity first, and let action lift your mood.
你现在的心情怎么样？（1 = 很糟，10 = 很好）: How is your mood right now? (1 = very bad, 10 = very good)
从下面选一件，或写一件自己的：散步 10 分钟 / 泡杯喜欢的茶 / 听一首歌: Pick one below or write your own: a 10-minute walk / make a tea you like / listen to a song / tidy your desk / message a friend
你打算什么时候做？（现在 / 30 分钟后 / 今天下午 / 今天晚上）: When will you do it? (Now / in 30 minutes / this afternoon / this evening)
做这件事最大的阻碍是什么？你能怎么绕过它？: What's the biggest obstacle to doing it? How can you get around it?
对自己说：「我决定在____时候做____。做完后给自己一个肯定。」: Tell yourself: 'I'll do ____ at ____. When it's done, I'll give myself credit.'
情绪低落时最不想动，但行动反而是打破低落循环最有效的方式。: When you feel low, you least want to move, but action is the most effective way to break the low-mood cycle.
不需要做大事。泡杯茶也是一个了不起的开始。: It doesn't need to be big. Making a cup of tea is a great start.
记得做完后回来，看看你的心情分数有没有变化。: Remember to come back afterwards and see whether your mood score has changed.
如果好朋友遇到了你一样的困境，你会怎么安慰 TA？用同样的话对自己说。: If a good friend were in the same situation as you, how would you comfort them? Say the same words to yourself.
写下你现在正在经历的困难或不好的感受。不用评判，如实写就好。: Write down the difficulty or bad feeling you're going through now. No judging; just write it as it is.
提醒自己：有很多人和你有类似的经历。你不是唯一一个。写下「这是人类的共同体验，不: Remind yourself that many people have similar experiences. You're not the only one. Write: 'This is a shared human experience, not just my problem.'
想象你最好的朋友正在经历同样的事，你会对 TA 说什么？把那些话写下来。: Imagine your best friend going through the same thing. What would you say to them? Write those words down.
现在把这些话转向自己。把「你」换成「我」，大声或默默对自己说一遍。: Now turn those words towards yourself. Change 'you' to 'I' and say them aloud or silently.
双手交叉轻轻抱住自己的肩膀，左右交替轻拍 10 次（蝴蝶拍），感受自我拥抱的温暖: Cross your arms and gently hold your shoulders, then tap left and right in turn 10 times (the butterfly hug) and feel the warmth of hugging yourself.
我们总是对别人比对自己宽容得多。今天试试把善意留给自己。: We are usually much kinder to others than to ourselves. Today, try keeping some kindness for yourself.
你会对好朋友说「你怎么这么差劲」吗？当然不会。那为什么对自己说？: Would you say 'how can you be so useless' to a good friend? Of course not. So why say it to yourself?
你值得被温柔对待——尤其是被自己。: You deserve to be treated gently — especially by yourself.
情绪要爆发的时候用这四步紧急刹车：停下来 → 退后一步 → 观察 → 有意识地行: When emotions are about to explode, use these four steps as an emergency brake: Stop → Take a step back → Observe → Proceed mindfully.
无论正在做什么、说什么、想什么——立刻冻结。就像按了暂停键。: Whatever you're doing, saying or thinking — freeze right away, as if you'd pressed pause.
从当前情境中后退一步。可以物理上走开，也可以在心里退后。做一次深呼吸。: Step back from the situation. You can walk away physically or step back in your mind. Take one deep breath.
观察正在发生什么：身体什么感觉？心里在想什么？对方在做什么？不评判，只是看见。: Notice what's happening: how does your body feel? What are you thinking? What is the other person doing? No judging; just notice.
问自己：「什么行动对我的长期利益最好？」然后带着觉知做出选择。: Ask yourself: 'Which action is best for me in the long run?' Then make your choice with awareness.
情绪像一列高速列车。STOP 就是你的紧急刹车。: Emotions are like a high-speed train. STOP is your emergency brake.
深呼吸……好的，你已经拉开距离了。现在只是观察。: Deep breath... good, you've created some distance. Now just observe.
现在你可以做出更明智的选择，而不是被情绪推着走。: Now you can make a wiser choice instead of being pushed along by emotion.
用冰水刺激 + 剧烈运动 + 节奏呼吸 + 肌肉放松，在 5 分钟内把情绪温度降: Cold water + intense exercise + paced breathing + muscle relaxation to bring your emotional temperature down within 5 minutes.
用冰水洗脸、冰袋/冰毛巾敷在眼周和额头 30 秒。冷刺激会触发「潜水反射」，快速: Splash your face with cold water, or hold an ice pack or cold towel around your eyes and forehead for 30 seconds. The cold triggers the 'diving reflex', which quickly lowers your heart rate.
做 20 个开合跳、原地高抬腿跑 1 分钟，或快速爬几层楼梯。消耗肾上腺素。: Do 20 jumping jacks, run on the spot with high knees for 1 minute, or quickly climb a few flights of stairs to burn off adrenaline.
吸气 4 秒，呼气 6 秒。呼气比吸气长，激活副交感神经。做 6 轮。: Breathe in for 4 seconds and out for 6. A longer out-breath activates the parasympathetic system. Do 6 rounds.
从双手开始：握紧 5 秒 → 松开。然后肩膀、面部，各紧 5 秒 → 松开。: Start with your hands: clench for 5 seconds → release. Then your shoulders and face, tensing each for 5 seconds → release.
TIPP 是情绪灭火器。先用物理方法降温，再用呼吸收尾。: TIPP is an emotional fire extinguisher. Cool down physically first, then finish with breathing.
运动完了？很好。现在开始呼吸……让心率慢下来。: Done with the exercise? Great. Now start breathing... let your heart rate slow down.
你的情绪「温度」降下来了吗？记住这套方法，下次情绪风暴来时第一时间用。: Has your emotional 'temperature' come down? Remember this method and use it first next time an emotional storm hits.
理性心太冷，情感心太热。智慧心是两者的交汇——既尊重你的感受，又保持清醒判断。: Reasonable mind is too cold; emotion mind is too hot. Wise mind is where they meet — respecting your feelings while keeping clear judgement.
把注意力放到胸口。你现在的情绪是什么？有多强烈？不需要改变它，只是感知。: Bring your attention to your chest. What emotion are you feeling now? How strong is it? No need to change it; just notice.
把注意力移到额头。关于当前这件事，理性上你知道什么是对的？: Move your attention to your forehead. About this situation, what do you know rationally to be right?
把注意力移到腹部（丹田）。深呼吸，感觉情感和理性在这里交汇。问自己：我内心深处知: Move your attention to your belly. Breathe deeply and feel emotion and reason meeting here. Ask yourself: deep down, what do I know I should do?
不要着急。安静等一等。智慧心的声音往往是平静的、温和的、带着确定感的。: Don't rush. Wait quietly. Wise mind's voice is usually calm, gentle and sure.
不管答案是什么，对自己说「我听到了」。: Whatever the answer is, say to yourself, 'I hear it.'
情感心像热水，理性心像冰——智慧心是温水，两者融合。: Emotion mind is like hot water and reasonable mind like ice — wise mind is warm water, the two blended.
把手放在肚子上，感受呼吸带来的起伏。答案就在这里。: Put your hand on your belly and feel it rise and fall with your breath. The answer is here.
智慧心不会大喊大叫。它像一个安静的「知道」，你只需要听到它。: Wise mind doesn't shout. It's like a quiet 'knowing'; you just need to hear it.
有些事我们无法改变——不是认同它，而是停止和现实拔河。接纳是放下痛苦的起点。: Some things we can't change. Acceptance isn't approving of them; it's stopping the tug-of-war with reality. Acceptance is where letting go of suffering begins.
什么事让你反复想「这不应该发生」「这不公平」？写下来。: What keeps making you think 'this shouldn't have happened' or 'this isn't fair'? Write it down.
不管你多不愿意，这件事已经发生了。对自己说：「这就是现在的事实。」: However much you don't want it, it has already happened. Tell yourself: 'This is how things are right now.'
扫描身体——哪里在紧绷？下巴？肩膀？拳头？有意识地松开这些部位。: Scan your body — where is it tense? Your jaw? Shoulders? Fists? Consciously loosen those areas.
提醒自己：接纳 ≠ 赞成。我接受「下雨了」不代表我喜欢下雨。我只是不再和天气吵架: Remind yourself: accepting ≠ agreeing. Accepting that it's raining doesn't mean I like rain. I just stop arguing with the weather.
转向可以做的事: Turn to what you can do
既然这件事无法改变，那么在这个现实下，我可以为自己做些什么？写下一件。: Since this can't be changed, what can I do for myself within this reality? Write down one thing.
痛苦 = 事实 × 抗拒。事实无法改变，但我们可以减少抗拒。: Suffering = pain × resistance. The facts can't change, but we can reduce resistance.
你不需要喜欢它。只是停止和它拔河，把力气省下来做别的。: You don't have to like it. Just stop the tug-of-war and save your strength for other things.
接纳是一个过程，不是一次就完成的。每练一次就松开一点。: Acceptance is a process, not something done in one go. Each time you practise, you loosen a little more.
手握冰块 30-60 秒，用强烈的冷刺激「接管」大脑注意力，打断自伤冲动或极端情: When an emotion feels overwhelming, focus on a strong cold sensation (such as cold water or a cold towel) for 30–60 seconds to pull your attention back to the present.
从冰箱取一块冰，或用冰水浸湿毛巾。: Take a cold drink from the fridge, or soak a towel in cold water.
把冰块握在手心（或冰毛巾敷在手腕内侧/脖子后面）。感受那股强烈的冷。: Hold the cold towel on the inside of your wrist or the back of your neck. Notice the strong cold.
全部注意力放在冷的感觉上：温度、刺痛、指尖的麻……只是感受。: Put all your attention on the cold: the temperature, the tingling in your fingertips... just notice.
放下冰块，搓搓手掌。感觉手掌从冰冷到温暖的过程。: Put it down and rub your palms together. Feel your hands go from cold to warm.
现在的情绪和刚才相比怎么样？冰冷「接管」了一些注意力吗？: How is your emotion now compared with before? Has the cold drawn some of your attention?
冰块的冷感足够强烈，可以把大脑从情绪旋涡中拉出来。: A strong cold sensation can help pull your mind out of an emotional whirlpool.
你正在掌控——你选择感受冰冷，而不是被情绪淹没。: You're in control — you chose to focus on the cold instead of being swept away by the emotion.
如果一次不够，可以再来一轮。这是安全的替代方式。: If you still feel overwhelmed or unsafe, please contact someone you trust or a support hotline.
情绪让你想做 A，你偏偏做 B。害怕时走上前，沮丧时动起来，愤怒时放柔声音。用行: Emotion pushes you to do A; you do B instead. Step forward when afraid, get moving when low, soften your voice when angry. Use action to rewrite the emotion.
你现在感受到什么情绪？（比如恐惧、悲伤、愤怒、羞耻、内疚）: What emotion are you feeling now? (e.g. fear, sadness, anger, shame, guilt)
这个情绪让你想做什么？（比如恐惧→想逃避；悲伤→想缩在床上；愤怒→想攻击）: What does this emotion make you want to do? (e.g. fear → avoid; sadness → stay in bed; anger → lash out)
这个冲动行为对你的长期利益有帮助吗？如果没有，那就是反向行动的信号。: Does acting on this urge help your long-term interests? If not, that's the signal for opposite action.
写下和冲动相反的行动。恐惧→走上前；悲伤→出门散步；愤怒→说「我需要冷静一下」然: Write down the action opposite to the urge. Fear → step forward; sadness → go out for a walk; anger → say 'I need to calm down' and step away for a while.
关键：不是心不甘情不愿地做，而是全身心投入反向行动。身体语言、语气、表情都要跟上: The key: don't do it half-heartedly; throw yourself into the opposite action. Your body language, tone and expression should match.
情绪是信使，不是指挥官。你可以听到它的声音，但选择不同的行动。: Emotions are messengers, not commanders. You can hear what they say but choose a different action.
反向行动一开始会很不舒服——这正常。坚持做下去，情绪会跟着行动改变。: Opposite action can feel very uncomfortable at first — that's normal. Keep going and the emotion will change with the action.
你刚刚证明了：你不是情绪的奴隶。你有选择权。: You just proved that you're not a slave to your emotions. You have a choice.
最短的正念练习，随时可做。60 秒内把注意力带回此刻。: The shortest mindfulness practice, for any time. Bring your attention back to the present within 60 seconds.
调整姿势，感受身体与座椅/地面的接触点。: Adjust your posture and feel where your body touches the chair or floor.
做三次比平时更深、更慢的呼吸。: Take three breaths that are deeper and slower than usual.
注意力放在此刻：听到什么声音？皮肤有什么触感？空气是什么温度？: Bring your attention to this moment: what can you hear? What does your skin feel? What temperature is the air?
轻轻睁开眼睛，带着刚才的觉察回到日常。: Gently open your eyes and bring that awareness back into your day.
只需要 1 分钟，从忙碌中暂停一下。: Just 1 minute to pause from being busy.
不需要清空大脑，只是注意到「此刻」正在发生什么。: No need to empty your mind; just notice what is happening 'right now'.
1 分钟正念结束。这 60 秒是你送给自己的礼物。: 1 minute of mindfulness done. These 60 seconds were a gift to yourself.
把注意力像一束温柔的光，从头顶慢慢扫到脚趾，觉察身体每个部位的感受。: Let your attention move like a gentle beam of light from the top of your head down to your toes, noticing how each part of your body feels.
平躺或舒适坐下，闭上眼睛，做 3 次深呼吸。: Lie down or sit comfortably, close your eyes, and take 3 deep breaths.
把注意力放到头顶，感受温度。然后慢慢往下：额头、眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、下巴。: Bring your attention to the top of your head and feel its temperature. Then slowly move down: forehead, eyes, nose, mouth, jaw.
感受脖子和肩膀有没有紧绷。然后移到手臂、手肘、手腕、手掌、指尖。: Notice whether your neck and shoulders are tense. Then move to your arms, elbows, wrists, palms and fingertips.
注意胸腔的起伏和腹部的感觉。有没有什么紧绷或不适？: Notice your chest rising and falling and how your belly feels. Any tension or discomfort?
觉察腰部、背部、臀部与支撑面的接触。: Notice your lower back, back and hips touching the surface beneath you.
从大腿、膝盖、小腿到脚踝、脚掌、脚趾。: From your thighs, knees and calves to your ankles, soles and toes.
现在感受整个身体作为一个整体。深呼吸一次，慢慢睁开眼。: Now feel your whole body as one. Take a deep breath and slowly open your eyes.
让注意力像一束温柔的光，从头顶开始慢慢往下照……: Let your attention shine like a gentle beam of light, moving slowly down from the top of your head...
如果某个部位有紧张或不适，不需要改变它，只是注意到就好。: If an area feels tense or uncomfortable, there's no need to change it; just notice it.
你刚刚完成了一次全身的「问候」。常做身体扫描可以更早发现压力信号。: You've just 'greeted' your whole body. Regular body scans help you spot stress signals earlier.
5 样看到的、4 种听到的、3 种摸到的、2 种闻到的、1 种尝到的——用感官把: 5 things you can see, 4 you can hear, 3 you can touch, 2 you can smell, 1 you can taste — use your senses to bring yourself back to the present.
环顾四周，说出 5 样你能看到的东西。注意颜色、形状、光影。: Look around and name 5 things you can see. Notice colours, shapes, light and shadow.
闭上眼睛，听 4 种不同的声音。远处的、近处的、身体内部的……: Close your eyes and listen for 4 different sounds — far away, close by, inside your body...
触摸 3 种不同的材质。比如衣服的布料、桌面的温度、自己的皮肤。: Touch 3 different textures, such as the fabric of your clothes, the temperature of the table, your own skin.
闻一闻，能捕捉到 2 种气味吗？: Take a sniff. Can you pick up 2 smells?
感受嘴里的 1 种味道。哪怕只是口腔里残留的味道。: Notice 1 taste in your mouth, even if it's just a lingering taste.
深呼吸一次。你现在在这里，安全的，脚踏实地的。: Take one deep breath. You are here, now, safe and grounded.
当思绪把你带走时，五感是最好的锚——它们只存在于此刻。: When your thoughts carry you away, your senses are the best anchor — they only exist in the present.
不用找特别的东西，最普通的就好。重要的是去「注意到」。: No need to look for anything special; the most ordinary things are fine. What matters is noticing.
你已经回到当下了。下次焦虑或恐慌时，试试这个 5-4-3-2-1。: You're back in the present. Next time you feel anxious or panicky, try this 5-4-3-2-1.
拿一小块食物（比如一颗葡萄干），用 5 分钟慢慢观察、闻、咬、品尝，像第一次吃东: Take a small piece of food (such as a raisin) and spend 5 minutes slowly looking at it, smelling, biting and tasting it, as if eating for the first time.
拿一小块食物放在手心。仔细看它的颜色、纹理、形状，像从没见过一样。: Put a small piece of food in your palm. Look closely at its colour, texture and shape, as if you've never seen it before.
用手指轻轻触摸它。什么质感？粗糙？光滑？有弹性？: Touch it gently with your fingers. What does it feel like? Rough? Smooth? Springy?
放到鼻子下方闻一闻。注意口腔有没有开始分泌唾液。: Hold it under your nose and smell it. Notice whether your mouth starts to water.
轻轻放在舌头上，先不要咬。感受它在口腔里的存在感和温度。: Place it gently on your tongue without biting yet. Feel its presence and temperature in your mouth.
慢慢咬下第一口。注意味道的变化、质地的变化。每一口嚼 20 次再吞。: Slowly take the first bite. Notice how the taste and texture change. Chew each bite 20 times before swallowing.
吞下去后，感受食物沿食道滑下的感觉。你满足了吗？: After swallowing, feel the food slide down your throat. Do you feel satisfied?
我们平时吃东西太快了，快到根本没「尝到」味道。: We usually eat so fast that we don't really taste our food.
像外星人第一次见到这种食物一样——充满好奇。: Be like an alien seeing this food for the first time — full of curiosity.
这 5 分钟里你比平时一整顿饭更「在场」。如果常这样吃一两口，消化和饱足感都会改: In these 5 minutes you were more 'present' than during a whole normal meal. Eating a bite or two like this often can improve digestion and fullness.
走路时把注意力放在脚底的感觉上——脚跟落地、脚掌展开、脚趾蹬地。慢一点，再慢一点: As you walk, focus on the feeling in the soles of your feet — heel landing, sole spreading, toes pushing off. Slower, and slower still.
原地站好，感受双脚踩在地面上的感觉。重心在哪里？: Stand still and feel your feet on the ground. Where is your weight?
比平时慢一倍地走。注意每一步：抬脚——移动——落地。: Walk at half your usual speed. Notice each step: lift — move — place.
每一步都关注脚底的感觉：脚跟触地——重心前移——脚掌压地——脚趾蹬地。: With every step, notice your soles: heel touches down — weight shifts forward — sole presses down — toes push off.
在保持脚底觉知的同时，也注意到周围的景色、空气的温度、身上的衣物。: While staying aware of your soles, also notice the scenery around you, the temperature of the air and the clothes on your body.
慢慢停下来，站立片刻。感受从走到停的过渡。: Slowly come to a stop and stand for a moment. Feel the change from walking to stillness.
走路本身就是一种冥想，只需要慢下来，注意到双脚。: Walking itself is a meditation; you just need to slow down and notice your feet.
抬……移……落……你和大地之间的对话，从来没有停过。: Lift... move... place... the conversation between you and the ground never stops.
任何时候走路都可以做正念步行——去茶水间、去地铁站、饭后散步。: You can walk mindfully any time — to the kitchen, to the station, on a walk after a meal.
依次向自己、亲人、陌生人、困难的人送出善意的祝福。「愿你快乐，愿你平安，愿你健康: Send kind wishes in turn to yourself, loved ones, strangers and difficult people: 'May you be happy, may you be safe, may you be healthy.'
默念：「愿我快乐，愿我平安，愿我健康，愿我自在。」重复 3 遍。: Silently say: 'May I be happy, may I be safe, may I be healthy, may I be at ease.' Repeat 3 times.
想一个你爱的人。默念：「愿你快乐，愿你平安，愿你健康，愿你自在。」重复 3 遍。: Think of someone you love. Silently say: 'May you be happy, may you be safe, may you be healthy, may you be at ease.' Repeat 3 times.
想一个你不太熟的人（便利店店员、路上行人）。送出同样的祝福。: Think of someone you don't know well (a shop assistant, a passer-by). Send them the same wishes.
如果可以的话，想一个你有些矛盾的人。试着送出祝福。做不到就跳过，没关系。: If you can, think of someone you have some conflict with. Try sending them good wishes. If you can't, skip it; that's fine.
把祝福扩大到所有人：「愿所有人快乐，愿所有人平安。」感受善意向四面八方扩散。: Extend the wishes to everyone: 'May all people be happy, may all people be safe.' Feel the goodwill spreading in every direction.
慈悲冥想就像心灵的热身——让善意的肌肉更有力量。: Loving-kindness meditation is like a warm-up for the heart — it strengthens the muscle of kindness.
如果对自己说「愿我快乐」感觉别扭，这很正常。继续练，会越来越自然。: If saying 'may I be happy' to yourself feels awkward, that's normal. Keep practising and it will feel more natural.
你刚才向世界发送了善意。这份善意首先温暖的是你自己。: You've just sent goodwill out into the world. This goodwill warms you first of all.
想象一条小溪，把你的每个念头放在一片叶子上，看着它顺水漂走。不抓住，不推开。: Imagine a stream. Place each thought on a leaf and watch it float away. Don't grab it; don't push it away.
闭上眼睛，想象你坐在一条小溪旁。水面上漂浮着落叶。: Close your eyes and imagine sitting beside a stream. Leaves are floating on the water.
注意到脑海中冒出的第一个念头——可以是想法、画面、声音、情绪。: Notice the first thing that comes into your mind — a thought, image, sound or feeling.
把这个念头轻轻放在一片叶子上，看着它随着溪水慢慢漂远。: Gently place this thought on a leaf and watch it drift slowly away on the water.
下一个念头来了？再放一片叶子。不管什么念头——好的、坏的、无聊的——都放上去漂走: Another thought? Put it on another leaf. Whatever the thought — good, bad or boring — place it on a leaf and let it float away.
慢慢让小溪的画面淡去。做一次深呼吸，睁开眼睛。: Slowly let the image of the stream fade. Take a deep breath and open your eyes.
念头就像天上的云、溪上的叶——它们来了又走。你不是念头本身。: Thoughts are like clouds in the sky or leaves on a stream — they come and go. You are not your thoughts.
如果溪水停了，可能你不小心抓住了某个念头。没关系，再放手就好。: If the stream stops, you may have grabbed hold of a thought. That's okay; just let go again.
你学会了一件事：你可以看着念头来来去去，而不被它带走。: You've learned something: you can watch thoughts come and go without being carried away by them.
躺在床上用感官倒数，从 5 样看到的到 1 种尝到的，把心思从纷扰的白天拉回安静: Lying in bed, count down with your senses from 5 things you saw to 1 thing you tasted, bringing your mind from the busy day to a quiet night.
闭上眼，在脑海中描述 5 样你今天看到的温暖画面。: With your eyes closed, describe 5 warm images you saw today.
回忆 4 种今天听到的声音。鸟叫、键盘声、笑声……: Recall 4 sounds you heard today: birdsong, typing, laughter...
感受 3 种此刻的触觉：被子的柔软、枕头的温度、身体的重量。: Feel 3 sensations right now: the softness of the duvet, the warmth of the pillow, the weight of your body.
数字越来越小，意识也越来越模糊……让自己慢慢滑入睡眠。: The numbers get smaller, your mind gets hazier... let yourself slowly slide into sleep.
今天发生了很多事，现在我们用感官慢慢收尾。: A lot happened today; now we gently wind down with our senses.
越来越少了……4……3……不需要想得太仔细。: Fewer and fewer... 4... 3... no need to think too hard.
让意识变得模糊……像一团棉花……柔软地……: Let your mind go hazy... like a ball of cotton wool... soft...
逐个肌群「紧张 5 秒 → 松开」，让大脑更清楚地感知「放松」是什么感觉。睡前做: Tense each muscle group for 5 seconds, then release, so your brain feels more clearly what 'relaxed' is like. Especially good before bed.
握紧拳头保持 5 秒，然后突然完全松开。感受手掌的温暖和放松。: Clench your fists for 5 seconds, then suddenly let go completely. Feel the warmth and relaxation in your hands.
弯曲手臂绷紧肱二头肌 5 秒，然后放松。: Bend your arms and tense your biceps for 5 seconds, then relax.
双肩用力提到耳朵附近 5 秒，然后让肩膀自然「掉下去」。: Lift your shoulders up towards your ears for 5 seconds, then let them drop naturally.
紧闭双眼、咬紧牙关、皱起鼻子 5 秒，然后放松面部所有肌肉。让嘴巴微微张开。: Squeeze your eyes shut, clench your teeth and scrunch your nose for 5 seconds, then relax every muscle in your face. Let your mouth fall slightly open.
下巴慢慢低向胸口，感受颈后的拉伸 5 秒，然后放松。: Slowly lower your chin towards your chest, feel the stretch at the back of your neck for 5 seconds, then relax.
收紧腹部肌肉（像有人要打你肚子）5 秒，然后放松。: Tighten your stomach muscles (as if bracing for a poke) for 5 seconds, then relax.
夹紧臀部、绷紧大腿 5 秒，然后放松。: Squeeze your buttocks and tense your thighs for 5 seconds, then relax.
脚尖用力向上勾 5 秒（小心抽筋），然后放松。: Pull your toes up towards you for 5 seconds (careful of cramp), then relax.
脚趾用力向下卷曲 5 秒，然后完全放松。: Curl your toes down hard for 5 seconds, then relax completely.
从头到脚感受一遍，享受全身放松的状态。如果哪里还紧，可以再做一次。: Feel your body from head to toe and enjoy the relaxed state. If anywhere is still tense, do it again.
我们从双手开始，一站一站地到达全身放松。: We'll start with the hands and work, stop by stop, towards a fully relaxed body.
紧张的时候用力——松开的时候彻底放掉。感受两者之间的对比。: Tense hard — then let go completely. Feel the contrast between the two.
全身都放松了。带着这份松弛，慢慢滑入睡眠吧。: Your whole body is relaxed. Carry this looseness with you and slowly slide into sleep.
想象身体变得越来越重，一点一点沉入床垫，像融化的巧克力一样铺展开来。: Imagine your body getting heavier and heavier, sinking little by little into the mattress and spreading out like melting chocolate.
平躺，感受身体与床接触的每一个点：后脑勺、肩胛骨、手肘、臀部、脚跟。: Lie on your back and feel every point where your body touches the bed: the back of your head, shoulder blades, elbows, hips, heels.
想象头变得越来越重，像一颗铅球慢慢陷入枕头。: Imagine your head getting heavier and heavier, like a lead ball sinking slowly into the pillow.
双肩和手臂变重，沉入床垫。手指完全不用力。: Your shoulders and arms get heavy and sink into the mattress. Your fingers don't hold anything.
整个躯干像灌了铅一样重。让重力帮你做放松的工作。: Your whole body feels as heavy as lead. Let gravity do the relaxing for you.
大腿、小腿、双脚……越来越重，越来越沉。: Thighs, calves, feet... heavier and heavier, sinking deeper.
整个身体融化在床上。你和床之间没有缝隙。每次呼气，再沉一点点。: Your whole body melts into the bed. There's no gap between you and the bed. With each out-breath, sink a little further.
不需要做任何事了。让身体去休息，让意识自由漂浮。: There's nothing more to do. Let your body rest and your mind float freely.
把所有的重量交给床，你什么都不需要撑着。: Hand all your weight over to the bed; you don't need to hold anything up.
每次呼气……再沉一点……再重一点……: With each out-breath... sink a little more... a little heavier...
在脑海中构建一个你感到完全安全和放松的地方——可以是海边、森林、童年的房间——然: In your mind, build a place where you feel completely safe and relaxed — a beach, a forest, your childhood bedroom — then 'step inside'.
想一个让你感到安全、温暖、放松的地方。可以是真实的，也可以想象的。: Think of a place that feels safe, warm and relaxing. It can be real or imagined.
走进这个地方。看看四周：什么颜色？什么光线？有什么东西？尽可能清晰。: Step into this place. Look around: what colours? What light? What's there? Make it as clear as possible.
这里有什么声音？海浪？鸟鸣？微风？壁炉的火苗？: What sounds are there? Waves? Birdsong? A breeze? A crackling fire?
温度怎么样？脚下踩着什么？微风拂过皮肤是什么感觉？: What's the temperature? What's under your feet? How does the breeze feel on your skin?
这里有什么气味？青草？大海？木头？花香？: What does it smell like here? Grass? The sea? Wood? Flowers?
找一个最舒服的位置坐下或躺下。这里完全安全，没有人打扰你。让自己在这里休息。: Find the most comfortable spot to sit or lie down. Here you are completely safe and nobody will disturb you. Let yourself rest here.
这个地方只属于你。任何时候你都可以来这里。: This place belongs only to you. You can come here any time.
让画面越来越清晰……你能闻到那个熟悉的气味吗？: Let the picture grow clearer... can you smell that familiar scent?
你已经安全到达了。在这里，一切都好。安心休息吧。: You've arrived safely. Here, everything is all right. Rest easy.
「清醒的睡眠」——身体完全放松，意识保持一丝觉知。介于清醒和睡眠之间的深度休息状: 'Conscious sleep': the body completely relaxed while the mind keeps a trace of awareness. A deeply restful state between waking and sleeping.
摆好大休息式：平躺，双腿分开与肩同宽，双臂放在身体两侧掌心向上。闭眼。: Get into resting pose: lie flat, legs shoulder-width apart, arms by your sides with palms up. Close your eyes.
对自己说一个正向的、简短的心愿。比如「我值得被好好对待」「我允许自己休息」。重复: Say a short, positive wish to yourself, such as 'I deserve to be treated well' or 'I allow myself to rest.' Repeat 3 times.
依次把注意力快速移过：右手指→掌→臂→肩→右脚趾→脚→腿→髋。然后左侧同样。最后: Move your attention quickly in turn: right fingers → palm → arm → shoulder → right toes → foot → leg → hip. Then the same on the left. Finally your torso and face.
观察自然的呼吸。从 27 开始倒数：呼——27，呼——26……如果数丢了就从 2: Watch your natural breath. Count down from 27: out — 27, out — 26... if you lose count, start again from 27.
先感受全身的重——然后轻；先感受温暖——然后凉爽。让身体在两种感觉之间流动。: First feel your whole body heavy — then light; first warm — then cool. Let your body move between the two.
在心里的屏幕上，让画面自然浮现。不控制，不追随，只是看着。: On the screen of your mind, let images appear naturally. Don't control them or follow them; just watch.
重复一遍最初的意念。慢慢摇动手指和脚趾。侧身弯曲，坐起来。: Repeat your intention once more. Slowly wiggle your fingers and toes. Roll to your side, curl up, and sit up.
在接下来的时间里，你唯一的任务就是——什么都不做。: For the next while, your only job is — to do nothing.
27……26……不需要努力。如果数字消失了，你可能快睡着了——这也很好。: 27... 26... no effort needed. If the numbers disappear, you may be nearly asleep — that's fine too.
你刚刚经历了一种比睡眠更深的休息。带着这份宁静，度过夜晚。: You've just had a rest deeper than sleep. Take this calm with you into the night.
结合呼吸和想象：每呼一口气，一只毛茸茸的绵羊翻过栅栏。比数数更有催眠效果。: Combine breath and imagery: with each out-breath, a fluffy sheep jumps over a fence. More sleep-inducing than counting numbers.
想象一片星空下的牧场，远处有一道矮矮的木栅栏。草地柔软，微风轻拂。: Imagine a meadow under a starry sky with a low wooden fence in the distance. The grass is soft and a light breeze is blowing.
吸气——一只白色绵羊慢慢走向栅栏。呼气——它轻轻跃过栅栏，消失在草地里。: Breathe in — a white sheep walks slowly towards the fence. Breathe out — it hops gently over and disappears into the grass.
每次呼吸就有一只绵羊翻过栅栏。不用数数，只是看着它们一只一只地跳过去。: With each breath, another sheep jumps the fence. No need to count; just watch them hop over one by one.
绵羊越来越模糊……栅栏越来越模糊……你也越来越模糊……: The sheep get blurrier... the fence gets blurrier... and so do you...
月光下的牧场，微风带着青草的气息。: A moonlit meadow, the breeze carrying the scent of grass.
一只……又一只……它们跳得很慢，很轻，很安静。: One... and another... they jump slowly, lightly, quietly.
不需要数了……让一切都模糊掉吧……: No need to count any more... let everything blur away...
25 分钟全力专注一件事 + 5 分钟彻底休息。最经典的时间管理方法。: 25 minutes of full focus on one thing + 5 minutes of complete rest. The classic time-management method.
写下这 25 分钟你要做的唯一一件事。只能是一件。: Write down the one thing you'll do in these 25 minutes. Just one.
手机静音翻过去。关掉无关标签页。告诉自己：25 分钟后再看。: Silence your phone and turn it face down. Close unrelated tabs. Tell yourself: I'll check in 25 minutes.
计时开始。全力投入。如果走神了，轻轻把注意力拉回来。: The timer starts. Give it everything. If your mind wanders, gently bring it back.
站起来！离开座位，喝水、看远处、伸展。不要看手机。: Stand up! Leave your seat, drink some water, look into the distance, stretch. Don't look at your phone.
只有一件事，25 分钟。你能做到的。: Just one thing, 25 minutes. You can do it.
走神了？没关系。轻轻回来，继续。: Mind wandered? That's fine. Gently come back and carry on.
25 分钟到！你做到了。现在彻底休息 5 分钟——你值得。: 25 minutes done! You did it. Now take a complete 5-minute break — you've earned it.
在 10 分钟内只做一件事，训练大脑从「多任务切换」模式回到「深度专注」模式。: Do only one thing for 10 minutes to train your brain to switch from multitasking back to deep focus.
你接下来 10 分钟要做什么？写下来。比如「读文章第 3 章」「整理邮箱」「写日: What will you do for the next 10 minutes? Write it down, e.g. 'read chapter 3', 'tidy my inbox', 'write my daily report'.
关闭所有和这个任务无关的东西。只留下完成这件事需要的界面/工具。: Close everything unrelated to the task. Keep only the screens and tools you need for it.
只做这一件事。想切换的冲动出现时，注意到它，然后回来继续。: Do only this one thing. When the urge to switch comes, notice it, then come back and carry on.
10 分钟里你走神了几次？每次是什么打断了你？了解自己的干扰模式。: How many times did your mind wander in 10 minutes? What interrupted you each time? Learn your own distraction patterns.
多任务是一个幻觉——大脑其实是在快速切换，每次切换都有代价。: Multitasking is an illusion — the brain is actually switching fast, and every switch has a cost.
想切换到别的事？先对自己说「再等 3 分钟」。冲动会过去的。: Want to switch to something else? First tell yourself, 'wait 3 more minutes.' The urge will pass.
你成功单任务了 10 分钟。这个能力每次练都会增强。: You single-tasked for 10 minutes. This ability gets stronger every time you practise.
选一个锚点（呼吸、声音或视觉焦点），注意力跑了就拉回来。像在健身房给注意力做力量: Choose an anchor (your breath, a sound or a visual point) and bring your attention back whenever it drifts. Strength training for your attention.
选一个：①腹部呼吸的起伏 ②环境中某个持续的声音 ③桌上一个小物件。把注意力放在: Pick one: ① your belly rising and falling ② a steady sound around you ③ a small object on your desk. Put your attention on it.
